depicted_variant: Raven Father lifting his beak like a hood to reveal a human face while first land emerges from primordial water.

visual_requirements.description: Raven form changing into a man by pushing up his beak
Earth emerging where everything was water, creator arriving from sky

aura: Visible beak-lifting transformation c03 and emergence of first land from water c02 distinguish the sacred creator from an ordinary raven.
artistic_choices: Human face beneath lifted beak is staged as transformation like a hood, intact/no gore; raven wings transition into two human arms, never extra arms plus wings.
Opaque feather cloak keeps body fully covered; no invented sacred markings or tribal regalia.
Close composition, antique gold sunset and surf are editorial atmosphere. Not copying Indigenous sacred artwork.
prompt:
ONE original square premium painterly cinematic Mitoloka illustration of Father Raven, Tulungersaq, the revered Alaskan Raven Father credited with making earth when all was water.
ANATOMY: ONE sacred RAVEN transforming into ONE MAN by PUSHING UP HIS BEAK [father-raven-c03]. Depict transformation as a whole black raven-head HOOD whose long beak is tilted upward above ONE human face. TWO HUMAN HANDS lift the raven hood from sides, TWO arms replace wings; NO separate extra wings. ONE human face with two natural eyes under hood, no second bird eyes visible. Fully opaque black feather cloak covers body completely, two legs mostly hidden beneath cloak. Transformation is seamless, no wounds or gore.
MOMENT: Rise out of primordial water and forcefully lift beak-hood, revealing an intent wise adult face looking down at viewer, as a rugged mass of first EARTH rises beneath him through the moving water.
POWER: land physically emerges from water at his feet, reflecting his making the earth when everything was covered in water, no energy beams or magical glyphs [father-raven-c02].
SCALE & CAMERA: extreme water-level close low angle; raven hood, face and both lifting hands dominate square, new rock pushes through foreground water, no invented giant scale comparator.
LIGHT & WEATHER: one low warm Arctic sunset rims glossy raven feathers and emerging wet earth; deep walnut shadows, physical sea spray, dark sky.
SURFACE: wet black raven feathers, worn human skin, opaque dense feather cloak, rough freshly exposed wet rock, moving seawater.
SETTING: primordial water with first land emerging, contextual Alaskan Arctic coast [father-raven-c02,father-raven-c04].
MOOD: reverent awe at wise active creator and transformation, never evil monster, cute mascot, ordinary raven or decorative portrait.
HARD CONSTRAINTS: no text, lettering, inscriptions, logo, border, frame or watermark; no extra heads, limbs or fingers; no design borrowed from any film, game, anime or comic; no nudity or explicit gore; no generic glow aura, neon outline or energy ribbons. Premium painterly brushwork, dark warm walnut and antique gold palette, square composition.
name: Father Raven
rationale: Every illustration must feel 'sangar': dangerous, imposing or awe-inspiring, with the being as the undeniable subject. The owner rejected earlier images that read as an ordinary person, an ordinary animal, an empty landscape, or a calm, cute or decorative portrait. Those outcomes are failures regardless of technical quality.

visual_review.notes: Native and 200px inspected: one transforming figure lifts raven beak/head as a hood to reveal human face; two human arms and no extra wings. Feather mantle fully opaque; first wet rock emerges in foreground sea spray. Tilted raven hood includes its physical eye as transitional remnant, not an independent second living head. Active transformation and primal land scene remain awe-inspiring at 200px; no text/aura/gore. Seven Sangar checks pass.

root_visual_review.notes: Viewed native 1254px + 200px + head crop. One sacred raven transforming into a man: the black raven head/beak is tilted up like a HOOD above a single wise human face with two natural human eyes (the one visible raven eye belongs to the lifted hood, not an extra human eye). Two human hands lift the hood from the sides and two arms take the place of wings — no separate extra wings (c03). Fully opaque black feather cloak; legs hidden in the surf. He rises from primordial water as a mass of first land pushes up through the moving sea beneath him (c02), on an Arctic coast with snowy peaks and a golden sunset (c04). Reverent, dignified awe; an original representation, not copied sacred bark art; no gore, beams, glyphs, text or aura. c02/c03/c04 satisfied.
